meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 会话里输入 /caveman-stats,它会原样打印已记录的 output 与 cache-read token 用量、响应次数和模式归属(若有);不要自己重算或重新取整。在 Gemini CLI 等其他宿主,它会指路到本机用量报告。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /caveman-stats 时触发,报告由 hook 提供;在 Gemini CLI 中它会改指 /stats model、/stats session 等命令。

say.note: 原样打印本次会话的 token 用量报告
汇总每个会话最近一次记录的 output 数
报告观测到的用量,节省量仍未知

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, /caveman-stats prints the recorded output and cache-read token usage, response counts and mode attribution for the session, verbatim — no recomputing. In other hosts it points to a native usage report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /caveman-stats in Claude Code. In Gemini CLI it redirects to /stats model or /stats session, without reading Claude Code transcripts.

say_en.note: Prints this session's token usage report verbatim.
Aggregates the latest recorded output count per session.
Reports observed usage; savings stay unknown.
